package config

import (
	"log"
	"time"

	"github.com/caarlos0/env/v10"
	"github.com/joho/godotenv"
)

type Config struct {
	AppName       string `env:"STAT_APP_NAME" envDefault:"statistic-service"`
	AppEnv        string `env:"STAT_APP_ENV" envDefault:"local"`
	HTTPHost      string `env:"STAT_HTTP_HOST" envDefault:"0.0.0.0"`
	HTTPPort      string `env:"STAT_HTTP_PORT" envDefault:"8080"`
	HTTPBasePath  string `env:"STAT_HTTP_BASE_PATH" envDefault:"/api/v1"`
	InternalToken string `env:"STAT_INTERNAL_TOKEN" envDefault:""`

	ClickHouseDSN      string        `env:"STAT_CLICKHOUSE_DSN" envDefault:"tcp://clickhouse:9000?database=default"`
	NATSURL            string        `env:"STAT_NATS_URL" envDefault:""`
	NATSPublishTimeout time.Duration `env:"STAT_NATS_PUBLISH_TIMEOUT" envDefault:"3s"`

	BatchSize         int           `env:"STAT_BATCH_SIZE" envDefault:"1000"`
	BatchFlushTimeout time.Duration `env:"STAT_BATCH_FLUSH_MS" envDefault:"500ms"`
	BufferSize        int           `env:"STAT_BUFFER_SIZE" envDefault:"4000"`
	ShutdownTimeout   time.Duration `env:"STAT_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT" envDefault:"5s"`
}

func Load() (*Config, error) {
	_ = godotenv.Load()

	cfg := &Config{}
	if err := env.Parse(cfg); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return cfg, nil
}

func MustLoad() *Config {
	cfg, err := Load()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("failed to load config: %v", err)
	}

	return cfg
}
